description: This file defines function declarations for fuel calculation and management in an engine control system. It includes functions for fuel injection timing, corrections based on sensor data, and engine parameters.

methods.name: initFuelMap
methods.description: Initializes the fuel map settings for the engine.

methods.name: getBaseFuel
methods.description: Returns total injection time into all cylinders before temperature corrections.

methods.name: getRunningFuel
methods.description: Returns base fuel with CLT and IAT corrections applied.

methods.name: getRealMafFuel
methods.description: Calculates fuel based on measured air mass and engine RPM.

methods.name: getBaseTableFuel
methods.description: Retrieves base fuel value from lookup tables based on RPM and engine load.

methods.name: getBaroCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction factor based on barometric pressure.

methods.name: getNumberOfInjections
methods.description: Determines number of fuel injections based on mode and engine parameters.

methods.name: getInjectionOffset
methods.description: Calculates injection timing offset based on RPM.

methods.name: getIatFuelCorrection
methods.description: Calculates fuel correction based on Intake Air Temperature.

methods.name: getInjectorLag
methods.description: Returns injector lag time based on battery voltage.

methods.name: getCltFuelCorrection
methods.description: Calculates fuel correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getFuelCutOffCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction for fuel cut-off conditions.

methods.name: getCltTimingCorrection
methods.description: Calculates ignition timing correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel
methods.description: Returns fuel amount needed during engine startup.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel3
methods.description: Returns fuel amount during cranking based on coolant temperature and revolution count.

methods.name: getInjectionDuration
methods.description: Calculates injection duration in milliseconds based on RPM.

methods.name: getInjectorDutyCycle
methods.description: Returns duty cycle percentage of the injector at given RPM.

methods.name: getFuelRate
methods.description: Converts injection duration and period into fuel rate in L/h.
